data.narrative:
Resilience is a Series D biotech & health company that has raised approximately $600M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 3 public peers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private counterparts in the same sector and stage, including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and New Limit.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-Progression, using the $600M total raised as a proxy for current value and applying a 1.5x multiplier typical of Series D progression, implies a $900M valuation. Peer-Median anchoring on 3 same-sector comparables yields a $3.8B valuation, with the median across Colossal ($10.3B), Chai ($3.8B), and New Limit ($3.1B) bounding a $3.1B–$10.3B range. Public-Comp anchoring via P/S multiples (8.1x median across the 3 public biotech tickers) is not applicable due to absent revenue disclosure.

The triangulated range is $765M–$4.4B, with a median of $2.4B. Stage-Progression anchors the floor; the peer median dominates the center estimate. Key uncertainties include the appropriate weighting of the stage-progression method against peer comparables when raised capital is substantially below peer valuations, and the wide dispersion within the peer set itself (3.1x spread between min and max). Revenue or near-term clinical/regulatory milestones would materially inform the positioning within this range.
